svg.title: I locked my CI's token to the floor, then handed eight strangers the keys
svg.desc: A single, centered, high-contrast diagram of a secure data pipeline: a large server rectangle with a lock icon, connected by a thick dashed line to a smaller client rectangle with a checkmark, all scaled to fill most of the frame. Trace Bloom generative banner for “I locked my CI's token to the floor, then handed eight strangers the keys”. A isometric lattice probed by 4 emitters; interference blooms mark where the wavefronts meet. Seed 2255423532.
